title: Redacting a share link on the product tour
caption: The share step of the product tour, held on one frame: for three seconds the report link is readable, then the masked version takes over and the link field is pixelated and blurred so the URL cannot be read.
prompt: The product tour ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 shows a live report link (hub.magnifito.demo/r/spring) in the Share report popover. Hold the frame at 15.75 s for 8 seconds and redact the link field with a blur mask (box 1340,336 to 1726,394). For the client, show the original frame for the first 3 seconds with an "Original frame" label, then cut to the redacted version labelled "Share link redacted", in Geist from fonts/.
commands: ffmpeg -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 8 -i work/frame.png -c:v libx264 -crf 14 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p work/still.mp4

ffmpeg -i work/still.mp4 -i work/redacted.mp4 -i work/label-original.png -i work/label-redacted.png -filter_complex "[0:v]trim=0:3,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a];[2:v]loop=-1:1,trim=0:3[la];[a][la]overlay=0:0[av];[1:v]trim=3:8,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[b];[3:v]loop=-1:1,trim=0:5[lb];[b][lb]overlay=0:0[bv];[av][bv]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/compare.mp4
credits: Screen: 02-product-demo from this showcase (mock dashboard SVGs, demo data; the link is fictional)
